name: mq
description: Amazon MQ is a managed message broker service for Apache ActiveMQ and RabbitMQ that makes it easy to set up and operate message brokers in the cloud.

subcommands.name: create-broker
subcommands.description: Creates a broker.

options.name: --authentication-strategy
options.description: Optional.

options.name: --auto-minor-version-upgrade
options.description: Enables automatic upgrades to new patch versions for brokers as new versions are released and supported by Amazon MQ.

options.name: --no-auto-minor-version-upgrade
options.description: Enables automatic upgrades to new patch versions for brokers as new versions are released and supported by Amazon MQ.

options.name: --broker-name
options.description: Required.

options.name: --configuration
options.description: A list of information about the configuration

options.name: --creator-request-id
options.description: The unique ID that the requester receives for the created broker.

options.name: --deployment-mode
options.description: Required.

options.name: --encryption-options
options.description: Encryption options for the broker

options.name: --engine-type
options.description: Required.

options.name: --engine-version
options.description: The broker engine version.

options.name: --host-instance-type
options.description: Required.

options.name: --ldap-server-metadata
options.description: Optional.

options.name: --logs
options.description: Enables Amazon CloudWatch logging for brokers

options.name: --maintenance-window-start-time
options.description: The parameters that determine the WeeklyStartTime

options.name: --publicly-accessible
options.description: Enables connections from applications outside of the VPC that hosts the broker's subnets.

options.name: --no-publicly-accessible
options.description: Enables connections from applications outside of the VPC that hosts the broker's subnets.

options.name: --security-groups
options.description: The list of rules (1 minimum, 125 maximum) that authorize connections to brokers

options.name: --storage-type
options.description: The broker's storage type

options.name: --subnet-ids
options.description: The list of groups that define which subnets and IP ranges the broker can use from different Availability Zones.

options.name: --tags
options.description: Create tags when creating the broker

options.name: --users
options.description: The list of broker users (persons or applications) who can access queues and topics.

options.name: --data-replication-mode
options.description: Defines whether this broker is a part of a data replication pair

options.name: --data-replication-primary-broker-arn
options.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the primary broker that is used to replicate data from in a data replication pair, and is applied to the replica broker.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.
